purpose: Teach: 滞納/突発/陽性/観衆/空爆/同伴/中流/卓越

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、税滞納絡みの詐欺を捜査されてますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating this case involving tax evasion fraud, are they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Leans forward with genuine curiosity. Pauses after the question mark—not rushing for an answer, but inviting one. Thoughtful cadence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、突発事案にも備えて訓練しております
lines.en: We train constantly to be ready for sudden incidents like that.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Professional confidence without stiffness. Even pacing. Slight nod in the voice—this is routine competence being stated factually.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬物検査で陽性となった事案を警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: And in cases where drug tests come back positive, the police handle those too, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost testing. Genuine question beneath the phrasing. Slight lift at the end—inviting confirmation, not accusing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、観衆が集まるイベント警備も担当します
lines.en: That's right. We also provide security at public events where crowds gather.
lines.style: Straightforward, informative. Clear delivery with no embellishment. Professional ease—explaining procedure without making it complicated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、過去の空爆遺物の不法売買を警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: Even cases involving illegal trafficking of artifacts from past conflicts—those are something the police investigate as well?
lines.style: Curious but careful. Slightly formal phrasing. Measuring the response. A pause before the final question mark—thoughtful, not pressing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、要人の同伴警備を行います
lines.en: We do. Close protection for VIPs is part of our duty too.
lines.style: Confident, assured. Brief and complete—no wasted words. A professional edge: this is what we do, no apology needed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、中流層を狙った詐欺を警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: So fraud targeting the middle class is something the police watch carefully for?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly concerned undertone. Genuine interest in how widespread the police consider this problem. Soft question mark—seeking understanding, not confrontation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、卓越した捜査技術を市民にもご紹介ください
lines.en: Officer, would you share some of your exceptional investigative techniques with the community?
lines.style: Warm and earnest. A genuine request, not a challenge. Direct eye contact in the voice. Respectful but comfortable—this is a colleague asking a colleague.
